svg.title: E8 roots in the Coxeter plane
svg.desc: The 240 roots of E8, built as the 120 unit icosians (blue dots) and the 120 golden roots phi times u (vermilion squares), projected onto an E8 Coxeter plane. They fall on 8 concentric rings of 30 with 30-fold symmetry: four rings of icosians and four golden rings, each golden ring phi times an icosian ring. Ring radii are listed at the right. Coordinates are computed, and the rings match the standard construction of E8.
svg.text: E8: 240 roots in the Coxeter plane
Two copies of the 600-cell's 120 points, one scaled by the golden ratio φ, make up E8's roots.
Each ring is one orbit of the Coxeter element,
Every golden ring is φ times an icosian ring.
240 roots, 8 rings of 30, computed. Inner product 2 × rational part; plane of the H4 Coxeter element on both halves.
The rings match the standard roots (±1,±1,0⁶) and (±½)⁸ projected on their own Coxeter plane.
